claims.text: After his business failed (1985), Kiyosaki and Kim were homeless and slept in a car for a time; by his own account in You Can Choose to Be Rich, an old Toyota.
claims.uncertainty: Homelessness and the car rest on the Kiyosakis' own accounts, retold by two independent secondary pages; the Toyota make is named by one page only; the book itself was not read.

claims.text: Musk says Tesla's rescue round closed on Christmas Eve 2008, in the last hour possible, and that he put in the last of his own cash.
claims.uncertainty: Musk's own account; the exact amounts differ between reports and are not spoken.

claims.text: Trump's companies filed for Chapter 11 six times (1991, three in 1992, 2004, 2009); corporate, not personal.
claims.uncertainty: Four when the three 1992 filings are counted as one; the line says his companies, not he.

claims.text: Belfort pleaded guilty to securities fraud and money laundering in 1999 and served 22 months.
